REFINEMENT (round-1 canonical panel, 2026-06-04) — make the enforce-flip prerequisite a MACHINE gate, not prose (fitness + historical TOP recommendation). The 7-item + P8-P11 gate is currently a human checklist; a flip executed on a prerequisite merely BELIEVED green is the highest-consequence false-green in the epic (it is the security invariant itself).
ADD a required CI check "no-dormant-security-check" that fails CLOSED if any security check is built-but-unwired — e.g. the admin-exemption consult path unreachable (DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER unset), or review-convergence-check.sh present-but-not-required. 3ee4 CANNOT flip while this audit is red. This would have caught DD4's dead ledger mechanically rather than via a dogfooding session.
Explicit checklist items to mechanize: (P8a) admin-exemption LIVENESS test green (3ebb DD4 (i)); (P8b) .closure-key provisioned to the coverage-invariant CI job (G-A); (P9) cca8 linear-history LANDED (promote from the soft blocks-link to a hard checklist gate — if 3ee4 flips before cca8, every PR2 exercises the clean-merge exemption + 4ba5 empty-net-diff path under ENFORCE = false-red wedge); (P11) 0cd7 DD8 net-diff fix LANDED (mitigates the merge-commit class if cca8 slips).
